async def index(req):
    return web.Response(text=HTML, content_type="text/html")


async def api(req):
    return web.json_response(req.app["eng"].snapshot())


async def feed(eng):
    st = []
    for p in eng.c["PAIRS"]:
        st += [p.lower() + "@depth10@100ms", p.lower() + "@trade"]
    url = "wss://stream.binance.com:9443/stream?streams=" + "/".join(st)
    delay = 1
    while True:
        try:
            async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as ses:
                async with ses.ws_connect(url, heartbeat=20, receive_timeout=60) as ws:
                    print("подключено", flush=True)
                    delay = 1
                    async for m in ws:
                        if m.type != aiohttp.WSMsgType.TEXT:
                            continue
                        try:
                            d = json.loads(m.data)
                            name, data, now = d["stream"], d["data"], time.time()
                            if "@depth" in name:
                                eng.on_book(name.split("@")[0].upper(),
                                            [(float(a), float(b)) for a, b in data["bids"]],
                                            [(float(a), float(b)) for a, b in data["asks"]], now)
                            elif "@trade" in name:
                                eng.on_trade(data["s"], float(data["p"]), float(data["q"]), bool(data["m"]), now)
                        except Exception:
                            traceback.print_exc()
        except Exception as e:
            print("ошибка соединения:", repr(e), flush=True)
        await asyncio.sleep(delay)
        delay = min(delay * 2, 30)


async def main():
    db = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    db.executescript(SCHEMA)
    eng = Engine(CFG, db)
    app = web.Application()
    app["eng"] = eng
    app.router.add_get("/", index)
    app.router.add_get("/api", api)
    runner = web.AppRunner(app)
    await runner.setup()
    await web.TCPSite(runner, "127.0.0.1", PORT).start()
    print("панель: http://127.0.0.1:%d" % PORT, flush=True)
    await feed(eng)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
